items.suggested_title: What is mold remediation? The 8-step process explained (North Las Vegas, NV)
items.notes: Definitional query, 1,000/mo at KD 18, and the exact passage shape AI assistants quote. Use the eight-step sequence ChatGPT already decomposes the topic into: inspection and moisture investigation, fix the moisture source, containment, removal of porous materials, HEPA cleaning, drying, independent clearance verification, reconstruction. Two differentiators to state outright: remediation is not removal (you cannot remove all mold spores from a building, you bring them back to normal levels), and clearance testing should be done by an independent inspector rather than the remediating contractor. Cover the EPA 10-square-foot DIY threshold so the post also catches 'is it safe to clean black mold yourself'. Lean on the IICRC AMRT and Certified Firm credentials, and note this absorbs the 'mold remediation process' keyword (720/mo, KD 16) so no separate process post gets queued.
